```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(GenomicRanges)
```

```{r}
# Read transposed genes
transposed_genes <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/98_1to1_orth_moved_genes.csv", header = T)
```

## Create a bed file with +/- 10 Kb flanking region for transposed genes (thaliana)
```{r}
transposed_genes_thaliana <- transposed_genes %>% dplyr::select(chr_thal,star_thal,end_thal,gene_id)
## Add +/- 10 KB to the both sides 
transposed_genes_thaliana$star_thal <- transposed_genes_thaliana$star_thal-10000
transposed_genes_thaliana$end_thal <- transposed_genes_thaliana$end_thal+10000
write.table(transposed_genes_thaliana,"/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/thaliana_98transposed_genes_10Kbplusmin.bed",quote     = F, row.names = F,col.names = F, sep="\t")
```
## Create a bed file with +/- 10 Kb flanking region for transposed genes in A. lyrata 
```{r}
# Read lyrata annotation
lyrata_annotation <- read.table(
  "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/mn47/GCA_944990045.1_MN47_v2_genomic.gtf",
  sep = "\t", quote = "", comment.char = "#", header = FALSE,
  col.names = c("seqname", "source", "feature", "start", "end",
                "score", "strand", "frame", "attributes"))

transposed_genes_lyrata <- transposed_genes %>% dplyr::select(gene_id,lyrata_start,lyrata_end,lyrata_chr)
genes <- lyrata_annotation %>%
  filter(feature == "gene") %>%
  mutate(
    lyrata_id = str_match(attributes, 'gene_id "([^"]+)"')[, 2],
    locus_tag = str_match(attributes, 'locus_tag "([^"]+)"')[, 2]
  )
# Change chr ids in lyrata
genes <- genes %>%
  mutate(lyrata_chr = case_when(
    seqname == "CALYLY010000001.1" ~ "Chr1",
    seqname == "CALYLY010000112.1" ~ "Chr2",
    seqname == "CALYLY010000223.1" ~ "Chr3",
    seqname == "CALYLY010000334.1" ~ "Chr4",
    seqname == "CALYLY010000445.1" ~ "Chr5",
    seqname == "CALYLY010000556.1" ~ "Chr6",
    seqname == "CALYLY010000667.1" ~ "Chr7",
    seqname == "CALYLY010000762.1" ~ "Chr8",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lyrata_chr))

## Build ranges and intersect with annotation ##
gr_annot <- GRanges(genes$lyrata_chr,
                    IRanges(genes$start, genes$end),
                    lyrata_id = genes$lyrata_id)

tg <- transposed_genes_lyrata %>% filter(!is.na(lyrata_start))
gr_tg <- GRanges(tg$lyrata_chr,
                 IRanges(pmin(tg$lyrata_start, tg$lyrata_end),
                         pmax(tg$lyrata_start, tg$lyrata_end)),
                 gene_id = tg$gene_id)

#Find overlaps
hits <- findOverlaps(gr_tg, gr_annot, ignore.strand = TRUE)

result <- data.frame(
  gene_id      = gr_tg$gene_id[queryHits(hits)],
  lyrata_chr   = as.character(seqnames(gr_tg))[queryHits(hits)],
  lyrata_start = start(gr_tg)[queryHits(hits)],
  lyrata_end   = end(gr_tg)[queryHits(hits)],
  lyrata_id    = gr_annot$lyrata_id[subjectHits(hits)],
  annot_start  = start(gr_annot)[subjectHits(hits)],
  annot_end    = end(gr_annot)[subjectHits(hits)],
  overlap_bp   = width(pintersect(gr_tg[queryHits(hits)],
                                  gr_annot[subjectHits(hits)]))
)

# Best overlap per gene id 
result_best <- result %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  slice_max(overlap_bp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

overlap <- inner_join(transposed_genes_lyrata,
                   result_best %>% dplyr::select(gene_id, lyrata_id, overlap_bp,annot_start,annot_end),
                   by = "gene_id") 

transposed_genes_lyrata <- overlap %>% dplyr::select(lyrata_chr,annot_start,annot_end,gene_id)
## Add +/- 10 KB to the both sides 
transposed_genes_lyrata$annot_start <- transposed_genes_lyrata$annot_start-10000
transposed_genes_lyrata$annot_end <- transposed_genes_lyrata$annot_end+10000

## Move chr back to the original naming 
transposed_genes_lyrata <- transposed_genes_lyrata %>%
  mutate(lyrata_chr = case_when(
    lyrata_chr == "Chr1" ~"CALYLY010000001.1",
    lyrata_chr == "Chr2" ~ "CALYLY010000112.1",
    lyrata_chr == "Chr3" ~ "CALYLY010000223.1",
    lyrata_chr == "Chr4" ~ "CALYLY010000334.1",
    lyrata_chr == "Chr5" ~ "CALYLY010000445.1",
    lyrata_chr == "Chr6" ~ "CALYLY010000556.1",
    lyrata_chr == "Chr7" ~ "CALYLY010000667.1",
    lyrata_chr == "Chr8" ~ "CALYLY010000762.1")) 


write.table(transposed_genes_lyrata,"/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/lyrata_thaliana_transposed_genes_10Kbplusmin.bed",quote     = F, row.names = F,col.names = F, sep="\t")
```

## Create a bed file with +/- 10 Kb flanking region for transposed genes in Capsella
```{r}
# First calculate how many 1-1 orthologous genes defined in 3 capsella genomes
capsella_transposed_genes <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/98_moved_gene_capsella_genomes.txt", sep="\t", header=T)
# How many genes have enteries in all 3 capsella genomes 
# function to check if a gene has a real hit (not NA, not "Not found")
has_hit <- function(x) !is.na(x) & x != "Not found"
set_grandiflora <- capsella_transposed_genes %>% filter(has_hit(C.grandiflora)) %>% pull(A.thaliana)
set_rubella     <- capsella_transposed_genes %>% filter(has_hit(C.rubella))     %>% pull(A.thaliana)
set_orientalis  <- capsella_transposed_genes %>% filter(has_hit(C.orientalis))  %>% pull(A.thaliana)

gene_sets <- list(
  C.grandiflora = set_grandiflora,
  C.rubella     = set_rubella,
  C.orientalis  = set_orientalis
)
```

```{r}
bar_dt <- data.frame(
  species = c("C.grandiflora", "C.rubella", "C.orientalis", "All 3 Capsella"),
  n_found = c(
    length(set_grandiflora),
    length(set_rubella),
    length(set_orientalis),
    length(Reduce(intersect, gene_sets))
  )
)

ggplot(bar_dt, aes(x = species, y = n_found, fill = species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_found), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("steelblue", "coral", "lightgreen", "purple")) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("C.grandiflora", "C.rubella", "C.orientalis", "All 3 Capsella")) +
  labs(
    x     = "Capsella species",
    y     = "Number of transposed genes with ortholog",
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```
## Get bed file for capsella rubella
```{r}
capsella_rub_annotation <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/capsella_genomes/Crubella_RAM_exon_v3.2.gff3")
colnames(capsella_rub_annotation) <- c("chromosome", "genome", "type", "start", "stop", "v6", "orientation", "v8", "id")
capsella_rub_annotation <- capsella_rub_annotation %>% filter(type == "gene")
capsella_rub_annotation$id <- gsub("ID=", "", capsella_rub_annotation$id)
## Select orthologous genes 
capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates <- inner_join(capsella_rub_annotation,capsella_transposed_genes, by=c("id"="C.rubella"))
capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates$start <- capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates$start-10000
capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates$stop <- capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates$stop+10000
capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates <- capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates %>% dplyr::select(chromosome,start,stop,A.thaliana)
write.table(capsella_transposed_genes_with_coordinates,"/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/syntenic_and_tranposed_genes/capsella_rubella_transposed_genes_10Kbplusmin.bed",quote     = F, row.names = F,col.names = F, sep="\t")
```
